title: Super Mario 64
shortDescription: A landmark 3D platforming adventure that turns movement, exploration, and playful experimentation into a whole new kind of course.
highlights: Open-ended castle exploration with distinct movement challenges
A readable 3D design language that rewards curiosity and precision

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A foundational Nintendo 64 selection whose movement vocabulary and exploratory structure make the transition to 3D immediately legible.
